events.title: If you added the demo and haven’t launched it yet
events.summary: I dropped the demo on September 21–22. Since then, not many people have launched it and played. I get why. Niche game, first-time maker. Still, one thing from my side.For at least 10 years I’ve wanted to make a game on my own. One day the idea for Dungeon Cooking hit me after I read The CRPG Book (Bitmap Books). After that book I started playing older games, and it was really through Beneath Apple Manor and Dungeon Campaign that I started thinking about making my own. That’s how Dungeon Cooking

events.title: A game that isn't afraid to let you down
events.summary: Dungeon Cooking comes out on November 19. Before it does, I want to say plainly what kind of game this is and how it was made.Why I'm making itNot to make money. I'm making a game that wouldn't have been afraid to come out in the eighties or nineties.Games like that barely come out anymore. I say "barely" on purpose, because the exceptions exist and I know them well. Someone is going to name a few titles in the comments and they will be right. I play those games myself.
